source: Cloud Billing Catalog API (services.skus.list), read with `sky ai cloud prices`; public list prices in USD, region us-central1 (Iowa, Americas)
note: Each rate is the sum of its catalogue SKUs, rounded up. Vertex AI custom training bills the machine (cores, RAM, GPU), its management fee and the boot disk; Cloud Run with a GPU bills instance-based CPU, memory and the GPU per second.

rates.cloudRunL4InstanceParts: L4 without zonal redundancy 0.0001867/s = 0.67212/h; 5 vCPU x 0.000018/s = 0.324/h; 20 GiB x 0.000002/GiB-s = 0.144/h; sum 1.14012

stageLimits.note: gcp-live.sh runs each of l2 to l5 under with_timeout stageSeconds, then cancels the run's live Vertex jobs and waits at most cancelWaitSeconds for them to end, and after l5 deletes the Cloud Run service. A job's ledger seconds count from its creation, PENDING and provisioning included; its scheduling.timeout counts only from RUNNING (the l4 job's 40 minutes did not bound runs of 3155 s and 3797 s), so the stage window plus the cancel wait is the bound. Cloud Build stops each build at cloudBuildTimeoutSeconds (sky-bundled/ai-cloud). The windows are set above the longest passing run of each stage.

stageWorstCaseBasis.l1: two Cloud Builds, each stopped at its 3600 s timeout: 2 x 60 min x USD 0.006 = 0.72; plus an allowance of USD 0.10 for about 25 GB of images kept for under a day
stageWorstCaseBasis.l2: a plan refused by its budget creates nothing: free
stageWorstCaseBasis.l3: four n2-standard-4 job chains at once (l3-once, l3-crash, l3-cancel, l3-budget), each for at most the 2700 s window plus the 600 s cancel wait: 4 x 3300 s x USD 0.30/h = 1.10
stageWorstCaseBasis.l4: one g2-standard-4 job chain for at most the 4500 s window plus the 600 s cancel wait, from job creation (PENDING and provisioning included): 5100 s x USD 0.95/h = 1.3458, rounded up to 1.35
stageWorstCaseBasis.l5: the l5-prep n2-standard-4 job chain and one Cloud Run L4 instance, each for at most the 3600 s window plus the 600 s cancel wait: 4200 s x (USD 0.30 + 1.14)/h = 1.68
